北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾重体感冷，-9℃注意保暖，出行小心哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels like -9℃. Dress warm and travel carefully!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光好，但体感5℃仍凉，记得添衣别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny, but feels like 5℃. Remember to add clothes to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感7℃微凉，湿度较高，多喝水哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels a bit cool at 7℃. Humidity is high, so drink more water!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴天，体感7℃略凉，湿度近饱，记得防潮哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels cool at 7℃. Humidity is very high, so mind the dampness!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，14℃舒适宜人，享受这好天气吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant at 14℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感4℃有风，出门别忘添外套哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 4℃ with wind. Don't forget your coat when going out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光虽好，体感4℃仍冷，出门记得多穿点！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, but feels cold at 4℃. Remember to wear more layers when you go out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感-1℃，湿度100%，出门注意保暖防湿！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like -1℃, humidity 100%. Dress warm and mind the dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雾气浓，体感1℃，请您出行慢，注意保暖防湿！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and feels like 1℃. Please drive slowly and keep warm and dry!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感-1℃，气温低干燥，记得多补水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like -1℃. It's cold and dry, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆雾蒙蒙，体感4℃，出行请注意安全和保暖防湿！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels like 4℃. Please travel safely and stay warm and dry!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨雾大体感-30℃！出门务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy and feels like -30℃! Bundle up completely and beware of frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -30℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳雾重体感-6℃，注意保暖防湿，出行也要小心！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is foggy and feels like -6℃. Dress warm, mind dampness, and travel safely!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感5℃有风，外出记得穿暖和点哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels like 5℃ with wind. Remember to dress warmly when going out!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，11℃微凉有风，别忘了添件薄外套哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, 11℃ and a bit cool with wind. Don't forget a light jacket!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾体感1℃，请注意防护保暖，出行也要小心！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze and feels like 1℃. Please protect yourself, stay warm, and travel carefully!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾体感-2℃，注意保暖防湿，出行请慢行！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and feels like -2℃. Dress warm, mind dampness, and drive slowly!
